structure.unit: Loans Secured by Lien on Real Estate

law.catch_line: Certain mortgages not to prohibit further encumbrance of real property
law.text: Where any loan is secured by a mortgage or deed of trust on real property comprised of one- to four-family residential dwelling units, the note, or mortgage or deed of trust evidencing such loan shall in no way prohibit the further encumbrance of the real property.
